name: TermSquad Open Graph social card by termsquad.com
description: A 1200×630 dark social card split roughly 55/45: the left column carries the wordmark, a three-line headline in a large humanist sans ("for AI agents." highlighted in pale green), a muted supporting sentence and a "Works with" icon row; the right half shows a mocked terminal/browser window with traffic-light dots and an agent conversation log in monospace, using green checks and role labels (Orchestrator / Implementer / Reviewer). The near-black background has faint diagonal light streaks, and the single green accent ties logo, headline emphasis and terminal statuses together, making the product's multi-agent concept legible at a glance.
